bullhorn_candidate_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a candidate changes in Bullhorn. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.candidate: The whole candidate as Bullhorn gives it.

output.is_open: True if the job is open.

output.owner_id: The id of the user who owns it.
output.title: Its title.

parameters.description: Only jobs this Bullhorn user owns. Leave empty for everyone's.

bullhorn_new_candidate_trigger.description: Runs for each new candidate in Bullhorn. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

parameters.description: Only candidates this Bullhorn user owns. Leave empty for everyone's.
